 Order

This Criminal Original Petition is filed seeking for a direction to the learned I Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli, to consider the bail application of the petitioners on the same day on merits in Crime No.21 of 2023 on the file of the second respondent.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2.It is submitted by the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners that the petitioners are the accused Nos.4 and 5 in Crime No.21 of 2023 on the file of the second respondent police, which was registered for the offences under Sections 376(1), 313, 294(b), 506(1) and 109 IPC and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989.

3.The petitioners submit that they intend to surrender before the learned I Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli, and sought for a direction to dispose of the bail https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No.16720 of 2023 application on the very same day in Crime No.21 of 2023 on the file of the second respondent.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4.The learned Government Advocate (criminal side) appearing for the official respondents submits that no previous case is pending against the petitioners.

5.Considering the circumstances, the petitioners are at liberty to surrender before the learned I Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli, within a period of 15 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

entities.text: I Additional District and Sessions Judge (PCR Cases), Tiruchirappalli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: If the petitioners surrender and file bail application, the learned Sessions Judge is directed to dispose of the same as per law as expeditiously as possible preferably on the same day by giving notice to the prosecutor and on hearing both sides.

6.It is needless to state that merely because this direction is given to dispose of the application as expeditiously as possible on the very same day, it does not mean that the bail application shall be allowed.
The learned Sessions Judge is required to hear both sides on merits and dispose of the same as per law.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Crl.O.P.(MD)No.16720 of 2023 7.

With the above directions, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
